list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY build_version

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, count() AS events FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (1) GROUP BY time LIMIT 1000

SELECT event_name, schema_version, count() AS events FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (1) GROUP BY event_name, schema_version LIMIT 1000

SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'stat') AS metric, sum(JSONExtractFloat(properties,'change')) AS value FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='stat_changed' AND startsWith(JSONExtractString(properties,'stat'),'telemetry_')) GROUP BY metric LIMIT 1000
